examples.english: Today there is a lot of rain in the afternoon.
examples.transliteration: El naharda matara kiteer ba'd el dohr.

examples.arabic: انا لسه سايقه العربيه عشان اجي البيت والمطره بدأت تنزل بغزاره
examples.english: I just drove the car to come home and the rain started falling heavily.
examples.transliteration: ana lessa sayqa el arabeya ashan agi el bet wel matara badat tenzel be ghazara

examples.arabic: طلعت ابص لقيت قطة صغيرة ماسكة مضلة ملونة ومستخبية من المطرة
examples.english: I went out to look and found a small cat holding a colorful umbrella, hiding from the rain.
examples.transliteration: Tala't aboss laqeet oTTa soghayyara mas'ka maDalla melawwana w mostakhabya men el maTara
